notes: «حدثني أبو الطاهر، أحمد بن عمرو بن سرح أخبرنا ابن وهب» : the two names are co-transmitters at one level (rule 2)
«قال قال ابن شهاب» : Yunus quotes Ibn Shihab, a link; «أن عائشة» (rule 5): Aisha is the Companion Urwa heard from; «زوج النبي» is a description, left out
the Prophet's words to the women are in the report's matn, Aisha's own speech is the saying
